text:
Alice: quick preflight — audit team is arriving for SOC2 fieldwork next Wed. Do we have a canonical list of non-prod KMS roles and who can grant them? want to avoid last-minute access tickets.
Ben: @Alice short answer: yes — runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/kms-runbook. I can grant temporary roles for auditors. which envs do you need? staging + shadow-prod?
Alice: staging + shadow-prod. also need HSM proof-of-possession checks covered (we're asked to show attestation flow).
Carla: can someone point me to PRs that touched keystore auth recently?need to cross-check changes for auditors.
Dmitri: PR #842 updated the assume-role flow and added an ephemeral creds helper. snippet to generate creds: 
```
./scripts/make_temp_key --env staging --ttl 4h
```
Ben: flow to grant: file an access request in Jira with label kms-fieldwork and list auditor identities. I'll approve once ticket shows env + duration. owners list I'm tracking: kms infra -> @Dmitri, keystore runbook -> @Carla, audit liaison -> @Maria.
Maria: noted. two small checks from compliance: auditors must have MFA and device inventory; also they should use the read-only role kms-audit-read.
sre-bot: Incident #3421: audit-log-ingest lag detected, current lag 2h. tagging eng-sre.
Carla: that ingest lag might block auditors reading logs in staging. I can run a one-off backfill if we can get the retention key unlocked. @Dmitri can you confirm rotation window?
Dmitri: rotation window is 02/20->02/22. For this week we can use kms-audit-read without rotating keys. I'll unlock retention key upon Ben's approval.
Ben: I'll prioritize the unlock after the Jira request is created. target approvals by Tue 11:30 so access cut can happen Tue EOD.
Alice: timeline noted. I'll open the Jira now and add the checklist: envs, auditor emails, TTL, required proofs (HSM attestation screenshot, ephemeral key id).
Carla: adding a short checklist to the runbook (docs): added section "fieldwork access checklist" and the ephemeral script example. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/keystore/pull/842
Maria: I'll validate auditors' device list once ticket's up. also can we get an excerpt of the audit-log schema they need? to ensure backfill includes fields.
Dmitri: sending schema in separate DM. quick IAM snippet for reference: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:ListKeys"], "Effect": "Allow", "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:role": "kms-audit-read"}}}]
}
```
Ben: blockers: 1) ingestion lag 2) retention key unlock. both actionable once Jira request is open.
Alice: i'll ping when ticket is created. thanks all for quick answers — tagging owners for visibility: @Dmitri @Carla @Ben @Maria :thumbsup:
